'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Yemeni Civil War (2014–present)|Yemeni Civil War]]
**[[Houthi–Saudi Arabian conflict]], [[Saudi Arabian-led intervention in Yemen]]
***[[Saudi Arabia]] proposes a [[ceasefire]] in [[Yemen]] to end the conflict against the [[Houthi movement]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2021/3/22/saudi-arabia-proposes-nationwide-truce-to-yemens-houthi-rebels (Al Jazeera)]
*[[Insurgency in the Maghreb (2002–present)|Insurgency in the Maghreb]]
**[[2021 Niger attacks]]
***The death toll from yesterday's raids in [[Tahoua Region|Tahoua]], [[Niger]], rises to at least 137. A security official blames [[ISIL]] for the attacks in a volatile region, which has seen an increase in these types of attacks in the past few months. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-niger-security/death-toll-from-niger-attacks-rises-to-at-least-60-mayor-idUSKBN2BE1IG (Reuters)] [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2021/3/22/gunmen-on-motorbikes-raid-niger-villages-kill-scores (Al Jazeera)]
*[[2021 Guangzhou bombing]]
**A man detonates a bomb in a [[government of China|government]] building in [[Guangzhou]], [[China]], killing four people [[suicide bombing|and himself]], along with injuring five others. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-china-blast-guangzhou/man-detonates-explosives-near-chinese-city-killing-four-idUSKBN2BE1ZX (Reuters)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[Balukhali fire]]
**A massive fire at the [[Balukhali refugee camp]] in [[Cox's Bazar]], [[Chittagong Division|Chittagong]], [[Bangladesh]], leaves at least 15 people dead, 550 injured, 400 missing, and 45,000 [[homeless]]. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-bangladesh-rohingya-fire-un/devastating-fire-at-rohingya-camp-in-bangladesh-kills-15-leaves-400-missing-un-idUSKBN2BF15G (Reuters)]
*Forty-five people are killed during a [[stampede]] at a stadium in [[Dar es Salaam]], [[Tanzania]], where hundreds of people were paying their last respects to [[President of Tanzania|President]] [[John Magufuli]], who died on 17 March. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2021/3/30/tanzanian-police-say-45-died-in-stampede-at-magufuli-tribute (Al Jazeera)]
*Two Taiwanese [[Northrop F-5|F-5E fighter jets]] collide with each other during a training exercise, with one pilot being declared dead and another missing. [https://www.upi.com/Top_News/World-News/2021/03/22/Taiwan-F5E-fighter-jet-collide-Taiwan/6041616421845/ (UPI)]

'''Health and environment'''
*[[COVID-19 pandemic]]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Asia]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in India]]
****[[India]] reports 46,951 new cases and 212 deaths in the past 24 hours, the highest daily case total since November and also the highest daily death total since January. [https://m.timesofindia.com/india/surge-in-fresh-covid-19-cases-india-records-46951-new-infections/amp_articleshow/81626326.cms (''The Times of India'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Jordan]]
****[[Jordan]] reports a record 109 deaths in the past 24 hours, thereby bringing the nationwide death toll to 5,985. [https://en.royanews.tv/news/26427/2021-03-22 (Roya News)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in the Philippines]]
****The [[Philippines]] reports a record 8,019 new confirmed cases in the past 24 hours, thereby bringing the nationwide total of confirmed cases to 671,792. [https://news.abs-cbn.com/news/03/22/21/phs-new-covid-19-cases-reach-record-high-of-8019-3rd-time-in-4-days (ABS-CBN News)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Taiwan]]
****[[Premier of Taiwan|Premier]] [[Su Tseng-chang]] receives a dose of the [[Oxford-AstraZeneca COVID-19 vaccine|Oxford-AstraZeneca]] [[COVID-19 vaccine|vaccine]] as the country begins its [[vaccination]] campaign. [https://www.straitstimes.com/asia/east-asia/taiwan-premier-gets-astrazeneca-shot-as-island-starts-covid-19-vaccine-campaign (''The Straits Times'')]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Europe]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Greece]]
****The [[Ministry of Health (Greece)|Ministry of Health]] orders private sector doctors to assist public hospitals as the public health system becomes overwhelmed by an increase in [[COVID-19]] hospitalizations. [https://apnews.com/article/health-coronavirus-pandemic-athens-greece-europe-be84984f224e1b29fa92d0d95fcd8c30 (AP)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Hungary]]
****[[Hungary]] grants emergency use approval for the [[CanSino Biologics]] [[Ad5-nCoV|Convidecia]] and [[India]]n [[Oxford-AstraZeneca COVID-19 vaccine|Covishield]] COVID-19 [[vaccine]]s. [https://dailynewshungary.com/hungary-approves-indian-vaccine-covishield-and-chinas-cansino-vaccine-for-emergency-use/ (Daily News Hungary)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Switzerland]]
****[[Swissmedic]] approves the use of the single-dose [[Johnson & Johnson COVID-19 vaccine|Johnson & Johnson]] [[COVID-19 vaccine|vaccine]]. [https://www.swissinfo.ch/eng/johnson---johnson-covid-vaccine-approved-for-use-in-switzerland/46469458 (Swiss Info)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in the United States]]
***[[COVID-19 vaccination in the United States]]
****Clinical trials for the [[Oxford–AstraZeneca COVID-19 vaccine|vaccine]] produced by [[University of Oxford|Oxford]] and [[AstraZeneca]] show that it is 79% effective against COVID-19. [https://www.nytimes.com/2021/03/22/business/astrazeneca-covid-vaccine.html (''The New York Times'')]

'''International relations'''
*[[China–European Union relations]]
**The [[European Union]] imposes sanctions against several officials in [[China]] for human rights abuses in [[Xinjiang]]. These sanctions are Europe's first since the [[1989 Tiananmen Square protests]]. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-eu-china-sanctions/eu-imposes-china-sanctions-over-xinjiang-abuses-first-in-three-decades-idUSKBN2BE1AI (Reuters)]
*[[Myanmar–United States relations]]
**The [[United States]] imposes sanctions against several military officials in [[Myanmar]] for its suppression of the [[2021 Myanmar protests|protests]] in response to the [[2021 Myanmar coup d'état|coup]]. [https://www.cnn.com/2021/03/22/politics/us-allies-burma-sanctions/index.html (CNN)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[2021 Boulder shooting]]
**Nine civilians and a police officer are killed during a [[mass shooting]] at a [[King Soopers]] supermarket in [[Boulder, Colorado]], United States. A suspect has been arrested. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-us-canada-56492541 (BBC News)]
*People protest in [[Bristol]], United Kingdom, against the proposed [[Police, Crime, Sentencing and Courts Bill]], which would give the police more power to deal with protests. [https://bbc.co.uk/news/uk-england-bristol-56477887 (BBC News)]

*[[2021 Republic of the Congo presidential election]], [[COVID-19 pandemic in the Republic of the Congo]]
**[[Guy Brice Parfait Kolélas]], the opposition presidential candidate, dies from COVID-19 on a plane en route to [[France]] for treatment, a day after the election. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2021/3/22/congos-opposition-candidate-kolelas-dies-a-day-after-poll (Al Jazeera)]
